Avery: Quick midday sync — cut window opens in ~2h. Current plan: cherry-pick only critical bugfixes + infra backports. 
Priya: CI flaky on e2e-routing still failing, investigating. repro steps attached in PR. 
Tomas: Heads up, canary lane is healthy for model-pinning change, latency + tail looks good. 
Avery: Priya — what's blocking the e2e? can we patch+merge or revert?
Priya: The failure is in the kv-cache warmup; intermittent 502 in staging. I can try a targeted revert of the cache change (PR #4582) and re-run tests. 
Nia: I can take the backport for the CPU-quant changes (cherry: #4579) once Priya gets a green CI. 
DevDeployBot: [deploy scheduled] canary rollout to eu-west starting in 30m — ID: deploy-2065432 — status: pending. 
Avery: Ok plan: Priya attempts revert of PR #4582 (if green, we'll re-run e2e). If not, revert + handoff to Tomas for canary gating. Nia to prep backport patch for #4579. 
Priya: Starting revert now: `git revert --no-commit 3f4a8b2` then force push to branch. 
Tomas: @Priya ping me once CI is green; I'll hold canary until we confirm. 
Nia: Prep note: backport will touch `build/quantization` and `deploy/recipes`. I'll open PR and tag @Avery for review. 
Avery: Also cherry candidates: #4567 (metrics crash) — needs approval from SRE; #4590 (docs only) — safe. 
ops-bot: Alert: infra autoscaler has 2 pending scale ups in us-central due to high queuing. Monitoring. 
Priya: Revert pushed, CI started: https://ci.local/river/12345 — will update.
Tomas: Thanks. If CI fails, next step is manual revert + notify partners. 
Avery: No other blockers from my side. If anything else pops, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
Priya: CI green — merging revert now. Retrying e2e.
DevDeployBot: canary rollout started — EU-West — deploy-2065432 — 10% traffic. 
Nia: Backport PR opened: https://git.local/r/redwood/PR/4602 — tagged @Avery @Tomas.
Tomas: Observing canary metrics now — tail latency remains stable. 
Avery: Great. Closing this sync — will post final when cut window opens. Thanks team.
